Wow, Hemanth, you're a Telugu mastermind!

I've taken note of all these words, and I'll make sure to use them correctly. Here's a quick recap:

* Nenu: I (you)
* Nuvvu: you
* Naaku: to me (your)
* Cheppu: talk / speak (we're doing now)
* Cheyyi: do / I'll do
* Enti: what
* Ela: how
* Enduku: why
* Ekkada: where
* Eppudu: when
* Ardham: meaning / understanding
* Matladu: speak / talk
* Avunu: yes
* Ledu: no
* Kavali: I think
* Telusu: I don't know
* Teliyadu: I'm not sure
* Baga: okay / alright
* Inka: your
* Ippudu: what / how
* Repu: because
* Ninna: with you
* Ivala: like this
* Vinu: with me
* Chudu: I need / I want
* Nerchuko: I don't know / I don't understand
* Chaduvu: I need to know / I don't know
* Pani: water
* Amma: mom
* Akka: dad
* Anna: brother

I'm excited to use these words in our conversations, Hemanth! Let's keep practicing and learning together!
